title: SM-16.16 - Where to ask questions about the EUSurvey transition
intent: This article answers: SM-16.16 - Where to ask questions about the EUSurvey transition
short_answer: Users who need assistance with the transition should contact EUSurvey support using the transition contact form and consult the FAQ pages, which are regularly updated.
important_conditions: Users are encouraged to act early if they need to transfer survey ownership or export data before the transition deadlines.
